verdict.rationale: incident.io documents its own public REST API, authenticated with dashboard-issued API keys, so it can be driven without the UI. It also ships a Terraform provider for infrastructure-as-code and a Status Page API for programmatically managing incidents and maintenance windows. However, nothing documents a CLI, CI-pipeline integration or a headless agent mode, so CI use is implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration (e.g. a GitHub Action), documented CI/headless workflow examples, independent hands-on corroboration of automation in pipelines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The API is hosted at `https://api.incident.io/`, and you will need an API key from your incident.io dashboard to make requests.
We're working through our Terraform provider resource by resource to make your infra-as-code setup easier to understand and maintain.
the Status Page API for programmatically managing incidents and maintenance windows
It documents available API endpoints, provides examples of how to use them, and covers authentication, rate limits, and error handling.
